objective: Correct Android external GIF share and phone gallery GIF selection so animated files can be attached to a chosen Community comment, while root-post GIFs remain restricted.
productionBaselineEvidence: Compared isolated DEV branch to GitHub main SHA 6d1a80e3d009aafcfd94444dc198cb8465e68c2f. Latest installed production OTA artifact, Android device playback and native sharing are not verified by this branch.
chosenApproach: Stage Android shared GIF into app cache before clearing share payload; wait for user to choose target post; preserve animation in the comment image picker; reuse private media upload and comment RPC with signed media URL resolving. No new native module or DB schema.
selectionRationale: Fix the existing wrong entrypoint and preserve comments and posting restrictions with minimal API changes. Avoid duplicating schema or writing orphan root posts, support delayed weak-network comment send.
alternativeApproaches: Automatically create a Community post from Android GIF share: rejected as wrong user intent and conflicts with root-post restrictions.
Transcode GIF to JPEG in photo picker: rejected because animation is lost.
Launch new Android native share-target Activity: unnecessary and would require an APK.
preserveBehaviors: Existing Community post GIF restrictions, post privacy and author checks
Existing comment RPC ownership, reactions, reply target and draft recovery
Other Android shares including text, still image and video behavior
Production native runtime, Expo SDK, Supabase RLS and storage bucket
acceptanceChecks: Phone GIF gallery preview retains original animation
Android external GIF waits for explicit comment target, does not auto-post
Shared file accessible after original Android share payload cleared
